task.title: [BUG] Seeding ETA should be visible
task.body: **Describe the bug** ETA might still be meaningful for seeding items when minimum seed time and/or minimum ratio is set. This is useful to know when an item will be free to be deleted or stopped upon satisfying tracker requirements. **To Reproduce** Go to seeding torrent details. **Expected behavior** ETA should still show as reported in the API **Screenshots** qbt WebUI: Currrent qRemote UI: **Additional context** This was intentionally changed in #113.
